title: Electroplating
definition: Electroplating is an electrolytic process in which a thin layer of metal is deposited onto the surface of a conductive object (substrate) by passing a direct electrical current through an aqueous solution containing metal ions.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims under Science and Technology (Physics/Chemistry interface, everyday applications, industrial chemistry) and Mains (GS-3 Industrial Pollution, Circular Economy, and Green Technologies).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Electroplating.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
